presets.label: Tornado Warning (Extreme)
presets.title: EXTREME ALERT: Tornado Warning
presets.message:
Tornado Warning in effect until 9:15 PM EDT.
A tornado warning has been issued for your area. Take cover now in a sturdy building.

presets.label: Severe Thunderstorm Warning (Severe)
presets.title: SEVERE ALERT: Severe Thunderstorm Warning
presets.message:
Severe Thunderstorm Warning until 7:45 PM EDT.
A severe thunderstorm capable of producing golf ball sized hail and damaging winds is approaching.

presets.label: Flash Flood Warning (Severe)
presets.title: SEVERE ALERT: Flash Flood Warning
presets.message:
Flash Flood Warning until midnight EDT.
Flash flooding is occurring or imminent. Do not attempt to travel in flooded areas.

presets.label: Flash Flood Watch (Moderate)
presets.title: MODERATE ALERT: Flash Flood Watch
presets.message:
Flash Flood Watch in effect through Wednesday morning.
Conditions are favorable for flash flooding.

presets.label: Hurricane Warning (Extreme)
presets.title: EXTREME ALERT: Hurricane Warning
presets.message:
Hurricane Warning in effect.
Hurricane conditions expected within 36 hours. Complete preparations immediately.

presets.label: Winter Storm Watch (Moderate)
presets.title: MODERATE ALERT: Winter Storm Watch
presets.message:
Winter Storm Watch from late tonight through Thursday morning.
Heavy snow possible. Total snowfall accumulations of 8 to 14 inches possible.

presets.label: Winter Storm Warning (Severe)
presets.title: SEVERE ALERT: Winter Storm Warning
presets.message:
Winter Storm Warning until 6 AM EST Thursday.
Heavy snow expected. Total snowfall accumulations of 10 to 16 inches.

presets.label: Dense Fog Advisory (Minor)
presets.title: MINOR ALERT: Dense Fog Advisory
presets.message:
Dense Fog Advisory until 10 AM EDT.
Visibility of one quarter mile or less expected.

presets.label: Frost Advisory (Minor)
presets.title: MINOR ALERT: Frost Advisory
presets.message:
Frost Advisory from 2 AM to 8 AM EDT.
Temperatures in the upper 20s to low 30s with light winds will result in frost formation.

presets.label: Heat Advisory (Moderate)
presets.title: MODERATE ALERT: Heat Advisory
presets.message:
Heat Advisory until 8 PM EDT this evening.
Heat index values up to 105 expected. Drink plenty of fluids.

presets.label: Special Weather Statement (Minor)
presets.title: MINOR ALERT: Special Weather Statement
presets.message:
Special Weather Statement.
A hazardous weather outlook is in effect for the area.

presets.label: Air Quality Alert (Unknown)
presets.title: UNKNOWN ALERT: Air Quality Alert
presets.message:
Air Quality Alert in effect.
Air quality index values are forecast to reach the Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups range.
